name: Moreno Valley Mall
description: Moreno Valley Mall is a regional shopping destination in the heart of Moreno Valley, California, featuring a diverse mix of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment including the popular Harkins Theatres MV 16. The mall offers convenient shopping with extended holiday hours and serves as a community gathering place for residents throughout Riverside County. With ample amenities and a family-friendly atmosphere, it provides a comprehensive retail experience for locals and visitors alike.
demographics: Moreno Valley Mall serves a diverse, family-oriented community in the Inland Empire with a median household income in the mid-range bracket and a predominately middle-class demographic. The trade area attracts value-conscious shoppers aged 25-54 with families, drawing from surrounding residential neighborhoods in Riverside County. Visitors typically seek affordable fashion, entertainment options like the Harkins Theatres, and convenient one-stop shopping experiences for everyday needs and weekend family outings.
summary: Moreno Valley Mall is a family-friendly regional shopping center featuring diverse retail, dining, and entertainment options including Harkins Theatres in the Inland Empire.
